claims.disproof_condition: 條件：全新的年報、法說或財報說明寫出 CW 雷射或光偵測器磊晶需求衰退、沒有新增客戶，或磷化銦磊晶片出貨營收下滑。核查頻率：每季（全新財報、法說）＋每年（年報）。觸發後 48 小時：本 claim 加註，全新敘事與 InP 磊晶片層讀圖重讀。
claims.statement: VPEC says AI data-centre demand made shipment revenue of its optoelectronic InP epitaxial wafers rise sharply (English text says 'In 2026'; the Chinese edition dates the same passage to FY2025), that 800G receiver shipments are set to double and 1.6T products have begun mass production, and that CW laser transmitter demand is expected to double with potential new customers. Supplier self-report; volumes and the CW variant (FP vs DFB, high-power) are not disclosed.

sources.quote: In 2026, due to the explosive increase in demand for high -speed optical communication components by AI servers data centers, shipment revenue of optoelectronic indium phosphide epitaxial wafers rose sharply, resulting in revenue growth.

Shipments of 800G receiver components are set to double, while 1.6T products have completed validation and begu n mass production. The increase in transmission speeds is expected to drive up average selling prices and profit margins. The demand for CW laser transmitters is also expected to double compared to last year, with the potential to acquire new customers and further expand market share.
